description: This is a test class for the ConceptSourceEditor, which interacts with ConceptSource objects within the OpenMRS property editing framework. It extends a base test class and uses Spring dependency injection to obtain a ConceptService for retrieving existing ConceptSource objects.

classes.name: ConceptSourceEditorTest
classes.description: Test class for the ConceptSourceEditor, verifies correct behavior of property editor for ConceptSource instances.

methods.name: getNewEditor
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ConceptSourceEditor for testing.

methods.name: getExistingObject
methods.description: Retrieves an existing ConceptSource object from the ConceptService using a predefined ID.
